column1: # Emoji for words whose emoji cannot be mistaken for anything else, used by tools/match_pictures.py.
# Matched on the word's English meaning (its first part, lower-case, without "a"/"the"). An emoji here wins over a
# Wikipedia photo, because lead photos are often of something nearby (a rain photo of a roof, a war for "boot").
# Where the app has a hand-checked photo for the emoji (assets/pictures/credits.tsv), it shows that photo instead.
# Numbers become digits and colours swatches in match_pictures.py itself, only for words in those topics.
